section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Intuitive Eating Scale 2 (IES-2), a 23-item instrument proposed by Tylka and Kroon van Diest designed to measure an individual's reliance on physiological hunger and satiety cues. The scale has a four-factor structure (UPE, EPRER, RHSC, BFCC) with a second-order factor of Intuitive Eating, and items are rated on a 5-point scale with higher scores indicating greater reliance on internal hunger cues. This is an instrument description section with no empirical study data, sample characteristics, or correlation results.
